const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib
p=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w47a-20260927/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-r9a1.json'))
assert p['candidate_identity']=='b9e8dd2ee1930fbb33a9f17d847af71155f46f3a8ff8b66f397293f864f8d419'
assert hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(p['payload'],ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()==p['candidate_identity']
issues={27:'冻结原文（tome-orcs/data/birth/worlds.lua:65）是“reclaim the far east and free it from Sunwall scum”，要求兽人重新夺回远东；译文“回到远东，并将其从太阳堡垒手中夺回”虽保留后半句夺回控制权，前半句把 reclaim 译为单纯返回，造成重复但未改变目标。',62:'冻结原文（tome-ashes-urhrok/data/lore/demon.lua:384）先明确附魔使复仇本能转向“former brethren”（原来的埃亚尔同胞），末句才讽刺地称这些被袭者为“tormentors”；译文末句“屠戮自己的‘折磨者’”将对象说成实际折磨他们的人，与前句所述被诱导攻击同胞的关系冲突。'}
# First candidate is not an issue: second half retains reclaim.
del issues[27]
v=[]
for i,k in enumerate(p['payload']['ordered_revision_keys'],1):
 d={'revision_key':k,'verdict':'ISSUE' if i in issues else 'OK'}
 if i in issues:d['observation']=issues[i]
 v.append(d)
print(json.dumps({'contract':'translation_contextual_v2','candidate_identity':p['candidate_identity'],'verdicts':v},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
PY",workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"May I verify the frozen candidate identity and produce the exact ordered compact JSON result?",max_output_tokens:10000});text(r.output);
